story.title: Nurturing Minds, Inspiring Futures
paragraphs: At Red Rose English Boarding School, we believe that every child has the potential to learn, grow, and make a difference. Guided by our motto, “For Knowledge and Virtue,” we provide a safe, caring, and inspiring environment where students develop strong academic foundations, confidence, creativity, and moral values.

Located in Hetauda-16, Hatiya, Makwanpur, our school brings together dedicated teachers, supportive parents, and a vibrant learning community. Through quality education, technology, sports, arts, leadership, and extracurricular activities, we prepare students not only for academic success but also to become responsible citizens, lifelong learners, and future leaders.

about.storyTitle: Shaping Minds. Building Character. Inspiring Futures.
storyParagraphs: At Red Rose English Boarding School, we believe that education is the foundation for successful lives and responsible communities. Located in Hetauda-16, Hatiya, Makwanpur, our school provides a safe, inclusive, and inspiring environment where every child is encouraged to discover their potential, embrace challenges, and grow with confidence. Guided by our motto, “For Knowledge and Virtue,” we nurture not only academic excellence but also integrity, respect, creativity, leadership, and social responsibility.

Our approach goes beyond textbooks, combining strong academics with practical learning, technology, sports, arts, leadership, and extracurricular opportunities. Through dedicated teachers, personalized guidance, and strong collaboration among parents, school, and community, we support the intellectual, emotional, physical, and social development of every learner. We strive to develop critical thinking, communication, collaboration, resilience, and problem-solving skills while inspiring curiosity and lifelong learning. At Red Rose English Boarding School, we don't just educate students—we inspire lifelong learners, responsible citizens, and future leaders.

messages.name: Sarita Bhandari Dahal
messages.title: Dear Students, Parents, and Visitors,
messages.message:
Welcome to Red Rose English Boarding School, where learning is inspired by our commitment to "For Knowledge and Virtue." We believe that every child possesses unique talents and the potential to achieve excellence when provided with the right guidance, opportunities, and encouragement.
Our dedicated team of educators works tirelessly to create a safe, inclusive, and stimulating learning environment that promotes academic achievement, character development, creativity, and lifelong learning. We strive to prepare our students not only for examinations but also for the challenges and opportunities of the future.
At Red Rose English Boarding School, we value the strong partnership between students, parents, teachers, and the community. Together, we nurture confident, compassionate, and responsible individuals who are ready to make a positive difference in society.
Thank you for visiting our website. We invite you to become a part of our school family and join us in shaping a brighter future for every child.

messages.name: Madan Dahal
messages.title: Dear Students, Parents, and Well-Wishers,
messages.message:
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Red Rose English Boarding School. When this institution was established, the vision was simple yet profound—to provide quality education that nurtures both knowledge and character, empowering young minds to become responsible, confident, and compassionate citizens.
Education is not merely about academic success; it is about developing values, discipline, curiosity, and the courage to face life's challenges. At Red Rose English Boarding School, we are committed to creating an environment where every child is respected, inspired, and encouraged to discover their full potential.
The success of our school is the result of the unwavering dedication of our teachers, the trust of our parents, the hard work of our students, and the continued support of our community. Together, we have built a learning community that strives for excellence while remaining grounded in integrity, respect, and service.
As we continue this journey, we remain committed to preparing our students not only for academic achievement but also for meaningful lives as ethical leaders and lifelong learners.
Thank you for your trust and confidence in Red Rose English Boarding School. We look forward to continuing this journey of excellence together.

journey.desc: As the school grew, it developed a safe, caring, and inspiring environment where every child could discover their abilities. Through academic excellence, discipline, and holistic development, Red Rose earned the confidence of parents and the respect of the wider community.

journey.desc: The school continuously strengthened its academic programs and embraced modern teaching methodologies. Technology was integrated into classrooms while students were given greater opportunities to develop their skills through sports, arts, leadership, and extracurricular activities.

journey.title: Beyond Textbooks
journey.desc: Red Rose believes that education extends beyond textbooks. The school focuses on developing critical thinking, creativity, communication, collaboration, and strong moral values, helping students become confident, responsible, and compassionate learners prepared for an ever-changing world.

journey.title: For Knowledge and Virtue
journey.desc: Today, Red Rose English Boarding School remains committed to innovation, excellence, and the holistic development of every student. Guided by the motto "For Knowledge and Virtue,"** the school continues to empower young minds to become responsible citizens, lifelong learners, and future leaders, supported by students, parents, teachers, alumni, and the entire Red Rose family.

posts.title: Annual Sports Day 2026: Celebrating Athletic Excellence & Team Spirit
posts.excerpt: Our annual school sports meet brought together students, teachers, and parents for an unforgettable day of track and field competitions, inter-house matches, and sportsmanship awards.
posts.content: Red Rose Secondary English School hosted its grand Annual Sports Day with unmatched enthusiasm and high-level athletic performance. Students across all grade levels competed in sprint races, relay competitions, long jump, chess, and football tournament finals. The Blue House claimed the overall championship trophy after an intense series of matches.
posts.author: Sports Department

posts.title: Students Win National Science & Robotics Competition Gold Medal
posts.excerpt: Our Grade 9 and 10 STEM innovation team secured the top prize at the National Inter-School Science Fair for their autonomous solar-powered water purification model.
posts.content: We are thrilled to announce that our young innovators from Red Rose Secondary English School achieved 1st place in the National Inter-School STEM Championship. Their project presented a cost-effective, IoT-monitored water filtration system designed for rural communities.
posts.author: Academic Council

posts.title: Red Rose Academic Excellence & Honor Roll Ceremony Announced
posts.excerpt: We proudly recognize our top academic achievers across primary and secondary levels for outstanding performance in term assessments, leadership, and community service.
posts.content: Academic dedication and consistent effort deserve celebration. During our special morning assembly, over forty students were awarded merit certificates and scholarships for achieving top percentile grades and demonstrating peer mentorship.
posts.author: Principal's Desk

posts.title: Grand Cultural Festival & Fine Arts Exhibition Highlights
posts.excerpt: A vibrant showcase of traditional music, drama performances, and student art galleries celebrating national heritage and creative expression.
posts.content: The annual Red Rose Cultural Extravaganza transformed our school School into a colorful hub of music, theatrical plays, folk dance, and fine art displays created by students from Grade 1 to Grade 10.
posts.author: Cultural Committee

posts.title: Notice: Parent-Teacher Progress Review & Interaction Conference
posts.excerpt: Inviting all parents and guardians to join our upcoming term evaluation and progress review meeting with class teachers and subject coordinators.
posts.content: Parental engagement is key to student success. All parents are requested to attend the interactive progress review session on Saturday between 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM.

facilities.title: Spaces Built For How Students Actually Learn smriti
facilities.subtitle: Red Rose Boarding School provides modern facilities that create an engaging, practical, and technology-driven learning environment for every student. smriti

facilities.title: Digital Library
facilities.description: A quiet, well-stocked reading room alongside e-books, journals, and research databases students can reach from any classroom.
facilities.details: Students can browse physical shelves or sign into digital collections — e-books, academic journals, reference databases, and curated learning platforms — all from a single login.

facilities.title: Tech Lab
facilities.description: A 40-seat computer lab where students get hands-on with the software and skills their exams — and future jobs — will actually ask for.
facilities.details: 40+ networked computers, programming environments, office software, and multimedia tools, with a teacher-led session every week from Grade 6 upward.

facilities.title: Science Center
facilities.description: Separate Physics, Chemistry, and Biology labs where the textbook diagram finally becomes something a student can hold.
facilities.details: Fully equipped, separately ventilated labs for each science stream, with safety gear, demonstration benches, and enough apparatus for every student to run their own experiment — not just watch one.

facilities.title: School Transport
facilities.description: Monitored bus routes across Hetauda, so getting to school safely isn't something a family has to solve on their own.
facilities.details: Red Rose Boarding School provides safe transportation with experienced drivers, route management, student safety monitoring, and comfortable buses for daily travel.

facilities.title: Performance Hall
facilities.description: A full auditorium for assemblies, cultural programs, and the kind of stage time that builds confidence a classroom can't.
facilities.details: Tiered seating, a proper sound and lighting rig, and a stage large enough for full-school assemblies, exhibitions, and end-of-year cultural programs.

facilities.title: Sports Complex
facilities.description: Open playgrounds and indoor courts where football, basketball, and volleyball teams train under proper coaching.
facilities.details: A full-size outdoor ground plus an indoor court, used for daily PE periods, house tournaments, and after-school training ahead of zonal and district competitions.

faqs.question: What is the admission procedure?
faqs.answer: Fill out the online inquiry form or visit our School. After submission, our admissions team will schedule an assessment and parent interaction session.

faqs.question: Is school transportation available?
faqs.answer: Yes, we operate safe and modern bus services covering major routes across the city.

faqs.question: Are hostel / residential facilities provided?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have separate well-equipped hostel facilities for boys and girls with 24/7 care and academic supervision.

faqs.question: What are the school hours?
faqs.answer: Regular school hours are from 9:00 AM to 3:30 PM, Sunday through Friday.
